definitions.gloss: to barricade oneself in; to hole up; to shut oneself in
definitions.explanation: To take refuge inside a building or enclosed space and refuse to come out, often in a standoff situation. Commonly used in news reports about hostage situations or sieges. Can also be used more casually for shutting oneself in a room.

examples.japanese: ⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ビル→ビル：01500_biru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{立|た}てこもった。
examples.english: The suspect barricaded himself in a building.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人質|ひとじち}→人質：09678_hitojichi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}って→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦{銀行|ぎんこう}→銀行：00578_ginkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{立|た}てこもる⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きた→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
examples.english: An incident occurred in which someone took hostages and barricaded themselves in a bank.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{立|た}てこもって⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{晩|ばん}→晩：00542_ban⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{勉強|べんきょう}していた→勉強する：00527_benkyousuru⟧。
examples.english: Before exams, I'd shut myself in my room and study from morning till night.

notes:
Godan verb (ら row): {立|た}てこもる・{立|た}てこもります
て-form: {立|た}てこもって
た-form: {立|た}てこもった

Also written as {立|た}て{籠|こ}もる with the kanji ⟦{籠|こ}もる→籠もる：07414_komoru⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦ビル→ビル：01500_biru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{立|た}てこもる (to barricade oneself in a building)
- ⟦{人質|ひとじち}→人質：09678_hitojichi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}って→取る：00565_toru⟧{立|た}てこもる (to take hostages and barricade oneself)
- ⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{立|た}てこもる (to shut oneself in a room)
- {立|た}てこもり⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧ (a barricade/siege incident)

USAGE:
Frequently appears in news reports about criminal incidents. In casual usage, it can describe someone who shuts themselves in a room to concentrate on something, though ⟦{引|ひ}きこもる→引きこもる：19546_hikikomoru⟧ is more common for that.
